sections.quote: Talk about yourself, your day, and your routine with confidence.

features.title: Introduce Yourself
features.description: Say your name, age, job, and where you live - clearly and simply.

features.title: Describe Your Day
features.description: Use the present simple to talk about your daily routine.

features.title: Aptis Ready

badge.title: FOUNDATION TRACK
badge.text: This is the first A1 module. It builds the sentence patterns needed for Family, Home & Possessions.

tip.title: Study Tip
tip.text: Short, simple sentences are the goal at A1. Focus on being accurate first - you will add length and detail later in the B2 modules.

sections.title: 1. Core Vocabulary: Daily Life
sections.description: Click cards to flip and listen. Say each word out loud three times.

cards.definition: I wake up at six o'clock every morning.
I get up and open the window.
I have breakfast at seven in the morning.
I go to work by bus.
I live in Hanoi with my family.
I am single. / My sister is married.
In my free time, I read books.
I usually cook dinner at home.
On Sundays, I stay at home and relax.
I go to bed at eleven o'clock.

tip.title: Pro-Tip
tip.text: Learn the whole chunk, not just one word: "have breakfast", "go to work", "go to bed". Chunks help you speak faster and sound natural.

sections.title: 2. Useful Chunks & Collocations
sections.description: Learn these high-frequency phrases as complete units.

points.title: get dressed
examples: I get dressed at half past six.
He gets dressed quickly before school.

points.title: take a shower
examples: I take a shower every morning.
She takes a shower after work.

points.title: have lunch with
examples: I have lunch with my colleagues.
Do you have lunch with your family on Sundays?

points.title: spend time with my family
points.function: dành thời gian cho gia đình
examples: I spend time with my family every evening.
We spend time with our family at the weekend.

points.title: on weekdays / at the weekend
points.function: vào ngày thường / vào cuối tuần
examples: I work hard on weekdays.
At the weekend, I visit my parents.

points.title: my favourite ... is ...
points.function: cái ... yêu thích của tôi là ...
examples: My favourite food is pho.
My favourite day is Sunday.

tip.title: Pro-Tip
tip.text: Notice the small words: "at the weekend" (British English) but "on weekends" is also common. Pick one form and use it consistently.

sections.title: 3. Grammar: Present Simple for Routines
sections.description: The present simple is the most important tense at A1-A2. We use it for habits, routines, and facts - exactly what you need for Aptis Speaking Part 1.

points.title: Affirmative (+)
points.function: I / you / we / they + verb · he / she / it + verb-s
examples: I work in a small shop.
She works in a hospital.
They live in Da Nang.
He has coffee every morning.

points.title: Questions & Short Answers (?)
points.function: Do / Does + subject + verb? · Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
examples: Do you live here? - Yes, I do.
Does she work? - No, she doesn't.
Where do you work?
What time does he get up?

points.title: Time Words & Frequency
points.function: at + time · on + day · in + part of day · always / usually / often / sometimes / never
examples: I get up at 6 a.m.
I play football on Saturdays.
In the evening, I cook dinner.
I never drink coffee at night.

tip.title: Common Mistake
tip.text: Don't forget the -s: "She work" is wrong, "She works" is correct. But after "does", use the base verb: "Does she work?" - not "Does she works?"

sections.title: Controlled Practice: Choose the Correct Answer
sections.description: Choose the best word or phrase to complete each sentence about daily life.

questions.prompt: Mai ______ up at six o'clock every morning.
questions.explanation: Mai = she, so the verb needs -s: gets. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: I ______ to work by bus every day.
questions.explanation: I takes the base form: go. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
Your brother = he, so we use Does. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
We takes the base form: watch. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
We use at with clock times: at seven o'clock.

questions.prompt: She ______ like coffee, but she loves tea.
questions.explanation: She = he/she/it, so the negative is doesn't + base verb.

tip.title: Strategy
tip.text: First find the subject: is it I/you/we/they or he/she/it? Then choose the verb form.

sections.title: Matching: When Does It Happen?
sections.description: Drag each activity or word to the correct group.

tip.title: Tip
tip.text: Think about your own day: what do you do in the morning, in the evening, and at the weekend?

tip.title: Reading Tip
tip.text: Read the whole sentence first. Which word makes sense? Then check: does the subject need verb-s?

sections.title: Listening: A Morning Routine
sections.description: Listen once for the main idea. Then listen again and answer the details.

audio.transcript: Hi, I'm Mai. On weekdays, I get up at six o'clock. I have breakfast with my sister at seven, and then I take the bus to work. I finish work at five. In the evening, I usually read a book or call my parents. I go to bed at about eleven.

gistQuestions.prompt: What is Mai mainly talking about?
gistQuestions.explanation: Mai describes the things she normally does from morning to bedtime on weekdays.

detailQuestions.prompt: How does Mai travel to work?
detailQuestions.explanation: She says, 'I take the bus to work.' Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

detailQuestions.prompt: What time does Mai finish work?
detailQuestions.explanation: She says, 'I finish work at five.' Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Listening Tip
tip.text: For the first listen, do not stop for every word. Listen for the person, topic and daily pattern.

sections.title: Speaking: Introduce Yourself
sections.description: Answer these two questions out loud. Speak for about 30 seconds. Then listen to the sample answer and compare.
questions: What's your name, and where do you live?
What do you do on a typical day?
sections.sampleAnswer: Hi, my name is Lan. I am twenty-four years old, and I live in Hanoi with my family. I work in a small office near my home. I usually get up at six o'clock and have breakfast at home. I go to work by bus. In the evening, I cook dinner and spend time with my family. I go to bed at about eleven o'clock.
sections.sampleAnswerTranslation: Xin chào, tôi tên là Lan. Tôi hai mươi bốn tuổi và tôi sống ở Hà Nội cùng gia đình. Tôi làm việc trong một văn phòng nhỏ gần nhà. Tôi thường thức dậy lúc sáu giờ và ăn sáng ở nhà. Tôi đi làm bằng xe buýt. Buổi tối, tôi nấu bữa tối và dành thời gian cho gia đình. Tôi đi ngủ vào khoảng mười một giờ.
prompts: Say your name and where you live.
Give two details about your typical day.
Use at least one time expression.

tip.title: Speaking Tip
tip.text: Use this simple plan: name and city -> job or study -> one or two routine details -> one free-time detail. Short and correct is better than long and confused.

sections.title: Writing: My Typical Day (30-50 words)
sections.description: Write a short paragraph about your typical day. Use the present simple and at least one time expression.

prompt.situation: A new friend wants to know about your daily routine. Write about your typical day: when you get up, where you work or study, and what you do in the evening.
prompt.referenceAnswer: My typical day starts at six o'clock. I get up and have breakfast at home. I go to work by bus and start at eight. In the evening, I usually cook dinner and spend time with my family. I go to bed at eleven o'clock.

tip.title: Writing Checklist
tip.text: Before you finish, check: 1) Is every verb in the present simple? 2) Does he/she have verb-s? 3) Did you use at least one time word (at 6 a.m., on Sundays)? 4) Is it 30-50 words?

sections.title: Quick Review: Are You Ready to Move On?
sections.description: Answer these quick questions to check your understanding of Lesson 1.

options: She go to work at eight.
She goes to work at eight.
She going to work at eight.
questions.explanation: He/she/it + verb-s: She goes. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
After Does, use the base verb: live. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
Use at with clock times. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: Which phrase means "an sang" (eat the morning meal)?
questions.explanation: have breakfast = ăn sáng. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
free time = thời gian rảnh. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
He/she/it + doesn't + base verb. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.
